{{Quote|Villpu Nagg. I have learned that a small Jedi strike force is on its way to destroy the weather station. Count Dooku's assassin is leading a commando unit to eliminate them.|Unger Gout, to Nagg|<ref name="SR2" />}}
'''Villpu Nagg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Confederacy took control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] and built a [[weather-control station]] on the [[Kafiri Mountain Range|Kafiri Mountain]] to defend the planet from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces. Nagg was placed in charge of the station, which created storms in order to prevent Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] from landing. The Republic, however, managed to [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|land]] several units on Khorm, and Nagg was contacted by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Unger Gout]]. The warlord informed him that two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were on the way to destroy the station and ordered Nagg to create a storm strong enough to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Jedi. The Aqualish obeyed and created the storm; however, the Jedi were able to redirect it on the station itself. The storm destroyed the station and killed Nagg.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I want you to generate a storm large enough to kill the Jedi.''"<br />"''What of the assassin? She'll be caught in the storm&mdash;''"<br />"''My orders are to defend our interests here with every resource at my disposal. That is what I intend to do. If that makes you feel uncomfortable, ask yourself this&mdash;are you comfortable with only one warrior standing between you and two Jedi Masters? Target those Jedi. Leave no survivors.|Gout and Nagg, during the Battle of Khorm|<ref name="SR2" />}}
[[File:Weather-control_station.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Nagg's weather control-station on Khorm]]
Villpu Nagg was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Nagg joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SR2" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Nagg was placed in command of a [[weather-control station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]], a world where the costly [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]], which increased the power of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], was found. The station was built on the [[Kafiri Mountain Range|Kafiri Mountain]] and was able to to create storms capable of preventing Republic forces from landing and capturing the agrocite [[Mining/Legends|mines]]. A Republic task force under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], however, managed to [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|land]] several [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on Khorm and capture a Confederate [[agrocite processing facility]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then decided to destroy the weather-control station in order to allow more reinforcements to land.<ref name="SR2" />

The Confederate [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Unger Gout]], then contacted Nagg and informed him of the Jedi threat. He also told him that the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was on her way to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Jedi, but nevertheless ordered Nagg to create a storm large enough to destroy the Jedi, as well as placing Ventress in danger. While Nagg was hesitant about the possibility of slaying Ventress, Gout insisted that Nagg carry out his orders. The Jedi survived, however, and managed to reach one of the station's junction boxes. With the help of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Fixer (clone trooper)|Fixer]], they [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] the box and changed the coordinates of the storm to target the weather-control station itself. The storm destroyed the station and killed Nagg and his staff.<ref name="SR2" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sir! Someone has realigned the storm's focal node&mdash;the storm's right on top of us!|A subordinate, to Nagg, shortly before their deaths|<ref name="SR2" />}}
Nagg was trusted enough to control Khorm's best defensive structure. Although Nagg was at first hesitant to kill Ventress along with the Jedi, Gout soon persuaded him that it was better than facing two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] alone. The Aqualish had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown skin.<ref name="SR2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Villpu Nagg appeared in [[The Clone Wars 8|second installment]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic|''In Service of the Republic'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The issue written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]],<ref name="SR2" /> and released on [[August 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-239/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-8|text=STAR WARS: THE CLONE WARS #8}}</ref>
